headlines.headline: ST. JOHN'S FORWARD BABACAR SANE GRANTED ELIGIBILITY VIA COURT ORDER
headlines.detail: A judge issued a temporary restraining order clearing St. John's forward Babacar Sane to play this season, the latest example of players using antitrust and due-process challenges to fight NCAA eligibility rulings ahead of the November tip-off.

headlines.headline: NBA RELEASES FULL 2026 PRESEASON SLATE AS OFFSEASON MOVES CONTINUE
headlines.detail: Preseason tips off October 3 with Heat-Raptors in Quebec City. Fred VanVleet opted into his $25M option with Houston, while LeBron James joining Philadelphia and Giannis Antetokounmpo teaming with Miami continue to reshape title odds.

headlines.headline: SEAHAWKS SURVIVE WITHOUT DARNOLD, TOP PATRIOTS 13-10 IN SUPER BOWL REMATCH
headlines.detail: Backup Drew Lock led Seattle to a 13-10 win over New England after starter Sam Darnold exited with a hip injury. The defending champs open 2026 at 1-0, though Darnold could miss multiple weeks.

headlines.headline: NO. 7 MIAMI HOSTS FAMU IN WEEK 2 HOME OPENER AT HARD ROCK STADIUM
headlines.detail: Miami plays its first home game of the season Thursday night against Florida A&M. Elsewhere, Rutgers turns to first-time starter AJ Surace at QB for Friday's trip to Boston College.
